summary: Completed backend testing of Iteration 27 features: Profile Customization API (display name editing fix) and AI Training System (Student→Master progression). All 21 backend tests passed (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileCustomization model at line 5921 includes: display_name, bio, chat_color, profile_picture, profile_logo, model_preset, model_colors, title_display, status_message, show_online, allow_whispers

GET /api/profile/customization/{user_id} returns: user_id, display_name, username, bio, chat_color, profile_picture, profile_logo, model_preset, model_colors, title_display, status_message, show_online, allow_whispers, legacy_usernames, auth_method
PUT /api/profile/customization/{user_id} validates display_name length (2-30 chars) and returns {updated: true, fields_updated: [...]}
ai_training_router included at line 7207-7208 with prefix /api
GET /api/ai-training/skills returns 24+ skills across 6 categories (combat, crafting, magic, social, knowledge, survival) with 7 mastery levels
Mastery levels: novice(0 XP, 20% efficiency) → student(100 XP, 40%) → apprentice(300 XP, 60%) → journeyman(600 XP, 75%) → expert(1000 XP, 85%) → master(2000 XP, 95%) → grandmaster(5000 XP, 100%)
POST /api/ai-training/train accepts trainer_id, entity_id, entity_type, skill_id, activity, duration_minutes, context and returns xp_gained, total_xp, current_level, efficiency, level_up

Training activities: observe_player(2 XP), assist_player(5 XP), practice_alone(3 XP), receive_lesson(10 XP), complete_task(8 XP), fail_and_learn(4 XP), study_materials(3 XP), teach_others(15 XP - requires Journeyman+)
GET /api/ai-training/entity/{entity_id}/skills returns skills grouped by_category with total_xp and overall_rating
GET /api/ai-training/leaderboard/{skill_id} returns top entities for a skill
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Used existing sirix_1_supreme user and elder_mira NPC for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 27 Profile Customization and AI Training APIs fully tested. Key endpoints: GET /api/profile/customization/{user_id} (returns display_name, username, profile_logo, auth_method, legacy_usernames), PUT /api/profile/customization/{user_id} (updates display_name with 2-30 char validation, returns {updated: true}), GET /api/ai-training/skills (24+ skills, 6 categories, 7 mastery levels), GET /api/ai-training/activities (8 activities with XP values), POST /api/ai-training/train (train NPC in skill, returns xp_gained/total_xp/level), GET /api/ai-training/entity/{entity_id}/skills (all skills for entity), GET /api/ai-training/entity/{entity_id}/skill/{skill_id} (detailed skill info), GET /api/ai-training/leaderboard/{skill_id} (top entities). ControlLayoutProvider integration in App.js was not tested (frontend testing skipped per request).
